title: Flexibility under Work Pass Framework to Hire Foreign Nurses to Meet Healthcare Sector Needs
what_it_is: Flexibility under Work Pass Framework to Hire Foreign Nurses to Meet Healthcare Sector Needs

sections.label: Foreign nurse hiring flexibility
sections.summary: Measures with MOM give healthcare sector additional work pass quotas and flexibility to recruit foreign nurses and support care staff.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health what are the measures taken with MOM to exercise appropriate flexibility under the work pass framework on the hiring of foreign nurses to meet the healthcare sector's manpower needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Hence, additional work pass quotas and greater flexibility to recruit foreign nurses and support care staff from non-traditional sources, have been allocated to the healthcare sector.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These measures have been used very judiciously by the sector.

sections.label: Foreign nurses' concern acknowledged
sections.summary: The Minister says the concern of foreign nurses is important and is being looked into specifically.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: To answer the question, yes, we are aware that this is an important concern of the foreign nurses, and yes, this is something that we are looking into specifically as well.
